embed.title: The Puls add-on is active 🎉
embed.lede: Thanks for activating. The last step is to connect your AI assistant (Claude, Cursor) to your store over MCP.
embed.step1: Sign in to Puls with the same e-mail you use in the Upgates admin.
embed.step2: In the dashboard, pick your AI assistant and allow the tool categories it may access.
embed.step3: Copy the MCP address into your AI client and start asking about orders, products and customers.
embed.connect: Sign in and connect the assistant
